sentences: Rain at Interlagos, a champion crowned in silver, and a brand new Formula E car hits the track today.

sentences.text: Good evening, I'm Pixie, and this is Racing Times.
sentences.say: Good evening, I'm Pixie, and this is Racing Times.

sentences: Here's what's on the grid this week.
Lando Norris masters the Brazilian rain.
Mercedes are your twenty twenty-six constructors' champions.

sentences.text: And Formula E's GEN4 era begins at Jarama.
sentences.say: And Formula E's Gen Four era begins at Harama.

sentences: Norris took pole, then took control, winning by fourteen point six seconds as the weather kept changing.
But the drive of the day belonged to Max Verstappen.
After grid penalties he started twenty-first, and finished second.

sentences.text: Isack Hadjar made it a double podium for Red Bull.
sentences.say: Isack Hadjar made it a double podium for Red Bull.

sentences.text: Russell and Antonelli came home fourth and fifth, and that was enough.
sentences.say: Russell and Antonelli came home fourth and fifth. And that was enough.

sentences: Mercedes are constructors' champions, with races to spare.

sentences.text: Today the whole grid gets its first proper run in the GEN4 car: five days of testing at Jarama.
sentences.say: Today, the whole grid gets its first proper run in the Gen Four car. Five days of testing, at Harama.

sentences: Then the new season opens in Jeddah on the eighteenth of December.
Still to come: Rafael Camara's surprise home debut, and a farewell to nineteen eighty world champion Alan Jones.
But first, the lights go out in Las Vegas this weekend.
